help.title: Help
help.description: Start with your first video and find steps whenever you need them.
help.noResults: No topics found. Try a shorter keyword.
help.tourNeedsProject: Open a video editing project to start the interface tour.
help.agentTourDescription: Access starts read-only and does not limit manual editing. Use Allow editing for Agent changes, then Set read-only to revoke access. Requirements records your goals.

help.tourComplete: Import a clip and drag it onto the timeline to try your first edit. Help in the title bar offers Quick Start, a searchable manual, and the tour.

storage.title: Data folder
storage.description: All user data — project database, media, the material library, settings and the Agent workspace — lives under one data folder you can move to another drive; uninstall can then remove it layer by layer.

settings.languageDescription: Choose the language for the ReelTerminal interface.

settings.enableAutoSaveDescription: Automatically save your project at regular intervals
settings.autoSaveTimingDescription: Changes save after a short pause, or by the maximum wait below.
settings.autoSaveFailedDescription: Your latest changes are still unsaved. Try saving again before closing.

editorTour.welcomeDescription: A quick map of the current editor layout: tools on the left, playback in the center, timeline below, and properties on the right.
editorTour.mediaDescription: This left panel changes with the tool rail: import media, add text, graphics, effects, and transitions from here.
editorTour.mediaTipLibrary: Media holds imported videos, audio, and images
editorTour.mediaTipToolRail: Use the left rail to switch to Text, Graphics, Effects, or Transitions
editorTour.mediaTipDrag: Drag assets from this panel onto the timeline
editorTour.mediaTipControls: The import and record controls live at the top of this panel
editorTour.timelineDescription: Arrange clips on tracks, trim edges, split selections, and use the zoom controls on the right side of the timeline bar.
editorTour.timelineTipSplit: Press S to split the selected clip
editorTour.timelineTipAddTrack: Use Add track when you need another video or audio lane
editorTour.playerDescription: The center player shows the current frame and playback controls. Crop, fit, and review changes here before export.
editorTour.playerTipControls: Use playback controls under the canvas
editorTour.playerTipLive: Open reference comparison from Compare when you need it
editorTour.playerTipFullscreen: Fullscreen and fit tools are in the player controls
editorTour.inspectorDescription: Select a clip to edit its properties. Transform, color, effects, speed, and animation controls appear here.
editorTour.inspectorTipTabs: Use the top tabs to switch between property groups
editorTour.inspectorTipClipSpecific: Color grading and effects are clip-specific
editorTour.inspectorTipKeyframes: Keyframe-capable controls show animation options when a clip is selected
editorTour.completeDescription: You now know where the main tools live. Use the action rail on the far left to reopen tours, settings, and project utilities.
